#   anubis-cmake -m //mode:linux_dev //mode:linux_release //mode:win_dev //mode:win_release -t //superdex_robotics:superdex_robotics //superdex_robotics:superdex_robotics_test -o anubis/cmake/CMakeLists.txt --namespace superdex
# Modes merged: //mode:linux_dev //mode:linux_release //mode:win_dev //mode:win_release
#
# Builds with your own GCC or Clang (clang-cl too). Use as a subdirectory
# (add_subdirectory / FetchContent) and link the `superdex::` targets.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(superdex LANGUAGES C CXX ASM)

set(_anubis_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../..")

# Flags are GCC/Clang flags. clang-cl gets each behind /clang:. cl.exe takes
# different flags altogether, so it isn't supported.
foreach(_lang C CXX)
  if(CMAKE_${_lang}_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "MSVC")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "superdex: MSVC's cl.exe isn't supported; use Clang (Visual Studio: -T ClangCL).")
  endif()
  if(CMAKE_${_lang}_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
    set(_anubis_${_lang}_flag "/clang:")
  else()
    set(_anubis_${_lang}_flag "")
  endif()
endforeach()

# //superdex_physics/libraries/mochi/third_party/marl:marl_fiber
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
add_library(superdex_marl_fiber STATIC)
add_library(superdex::marl_fiber ALIAS superdex_marl_fiber)
set_target_properties(superdex_marl_fiber PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "marl_fiber")
target_sources(superdex_marl_fiber
  PRIVATE
    "${_anubis_root}/superdex_physics/libraries/mochi/third_party/marl/marl/src/osfiber_x64.c"
    "${_anubis_root}/superdex_physics/libraries/mochi/third_party/marl/marl/src/osfiber_asm_x64.S"
)
target_compile_options(superdex_marl_fiber
  PRIVATE
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:${_anubis_C_flag}-w>"
)
target_include_directories(superdex_marl_fiber
  PRIVATE
    "${_anubis_root}/superdex_physics/libraries/mochi/third_party/marl/marl/include"
)
endif()
